chapter: Buddy Petit's death, Milneburg and halls
title: Zeb's death and background
summary: Zeb the clarinettist died before Buddy Petit; Penn knows little else and guesses he was born in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well yeah, I keep ending up this on a sad note, but I'm asking about these people because we never knew them. Zeb, do you know when did he die about? Was that before Buddy Petty or after, did you think?
Yes, Mr. Bill, Zeb died first. Before Buddy.
Yeah. I think Buddy died about 1931 I believe the date was.
Yeah, Zeb died first, because Zeb used to play with us, you know.
I never knew anybody much that knew anything about Zeb. Yeah.
But I didn't know no more than that about him. His name, I don't know.
He didn't know what part of town, or if he was born here in town, did you ever hear him
say anything about his life? Well I think he was born here in town because the head trumpet player used to be in the band, used to teach for y'all. Lewis the Man.

Lewis the Man. He used to live right close to Lewis the Man, right in the back of Lewis the Man. I think he was born and raised right here. Up in that section. I think that was about on 6th Street or 7th Street or something like that. That's right.

That's right. Maybe 3rd or 4th, anyway it was up in that section. It said it around a little bit. If I haven't any other questions to ask, is there something else you can think of that you'd like to add about your life?
Well, Mr. Bill, I think that's about all I know. I think you covered it very well actually. Right now, because I forgot so much. I remember a lot of it. You know how it is years ago like that.
